sourceText.he: הֲרֵי זוֹ כְּמִין רִבִּית וְכוּ׳. וְהָתַנְיָא: הֲרֵי זוֹ רִבִּית גְּמוּרָה, אֶלָּא שֶׁהַתּוֹרָה הִתִּירַתּוּ!

positions.claim: it is like a form of interest but is not interest
positions.basis: the buyer owned the house while he lived in it

positions.claim: it is fully interest, and the Torah permitted it here
